title: F5 BIG-IP Declarative Onboarding security declaration
description: Security properties for onboarding a BIG-IP.

class.description: Indicates that this property contains SecurityAnalytics configuration.

collectClientIpEnabled.description: Specifies whether source/client IP address should be collected for ACL rule matching.

collectClientPortEnabled.description: Specifies whether source/client port should be collected for ACL rule matching.

collectDestinationIpEnabled.description: Specifies whether the destination IP address should be collected for ACL rule matching.

collectDestinationPortEnabled.description: Specifies whether the destination port should be collected for ACL rule matching.

collectServerSideStatsEnabled.description: Specifies whether server side statistics (source address translation information, self IP address and pool member address) should be collected for ACL rule matching.

collectAllDosStatsEnabled.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable the collection of all DoS statistics.

collectedStatsExternalLoggingEnabled.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable external logging of collected statistics.

collectedStatsInternalLoggingEnabled.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable internal logging of collected statistics.

collectClientIpEnabled.description: Specifies whether source/client IP address should be collected for DNS security.

collectDestinationIpEnabled.description: Specifies whether the destination IP address should be collected for DNS security.

collectDnsStatsEnabled.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable DNS statistics collection.

collectClientIpEnabled.description: Specifies whether source/client IP address should be collected for network layer's DoS security.

collectDestinationGeoEnabled.description: Specifies whether the destination geo should be collected for network layer's DoS security.

collectDosL3StatsEnabled.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable the collection of DoS L3 statistics.

collectFirewallAclStatsEnabled.description: Specifies whther to enable or disable the collection of firewall ACL statistics.

collectFirewallDropsStatsEnabled.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable the collection of firewall drops statistics.

collectIpReputationStatsEnabled.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable the collection of IP reputation statistics.

collectClientIpEnabled.description: Specifies whether source/client IP address should be collected for firewall errors.

collectDestinationIpEnabled.description: Specifies whether the destination IP address should be collected for firewall errors.

publisher.description: Specifies the external logging publisher used to send statistical data to one or more destinations.

collectSipStatsEnabled.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable the collection of SIP statistics.

smtpConfig.description: Specifies the default SMTP configuration used for exporting CSV or PDF security analytics reports.

collectStaleRulesEnabled.description: Specifies whether statistics about all firewall rules should be collected in order to present information regarding rule staleness.

class.description: Indicates that this property contains SecurityWaf configuration.

guaranteeEnforcementEnabled.description: Specifies whether the system should perform virus checking even if this may slow down the web application.

name.description: Specifies the name of the setting.

value.description: Specifies the desired value for the setting.

name.description: Specifies the name of the setting.

value.description: Specifies the desired value for the setting.

networkDosMitigationPercentage.description: Percentage threshold for network DoS mitigation

sipDosMitigationPercentage.description: Percentage threshold for SIP DoS mitigation

synCookieDsrFlowResetBy.description: How to reset DSR flows under SYN cookie protection

synCookieWhitelist.description: Whether SYN cookie whitelist is enabled
